data: What is the classification result measured by F-measure at the threshold 0.7, in the second plot?

The question asks for the classification result measured by F-measure at the threshold 0.7 in the second plot. The second plot is the middle one in the compound figure. The F-measure line is represented by the green line in all three plots. At the threshold 0.7, the F-measure value can be read off the y-axis. In the second plot, the F-measure line intersects the y-axis at approximately 0.65. Therefore, the classification result measured by F-measure at the threshold 0.7 in the second plot is approximately 0.65.
